key.name: yt-dlp-path
key.description: Optional absolute path to yt-dlp. Empty uses PATH.

key.name: ffmpeg-path
key.description: Optional absolute path to ffmpeg. Empty uses PATH.

key.name: download-dir
key.description: Where media is saved. Empty uses ~/Downloads.

key.name: auto-clipboard
key.summary: Read URL from clipboard on open

key.name: auto-extract-clipboard
key.description: Off by default: opening the panel with auto-clipboard on will fill the field but won't extract/hit the network until you press Enter or the extract button.

key.name: write-subs-file
key.summary: Save subtitles as a separate file
key.description: Writes manually-authored subtitles to a sidecar file (independent of embedding).

key.name: reduce-motion
key.description: Disables the pulsing busy/extracting animation in favor of a static dim state.

key.name: clear-input-after-download
key.summary: Clear input after a successful download

key.name: audio-format
key.summary: Default audio format for new downloads

key.name: advanced-visible
key.summary: Whether the Advanced section is expanded

key.name: output-template
key.description: Passed to yt-dlp as the output template. Example: %(title)s.%(ext)s. Custom templates may prevent Ytrawl from predicting the exact output file path.

key.name: cookies
key.description: Optional path to a Netscape-format cookies.txt file. The file contains authentication data and should be kept private.

key.name: cookies-from-browser
key.summary: Browser to read live cookies from
key.description: Passed to yt-dlp's --cookies-from-browser option. Example: firefox or chrome. Reading browser cookies is sensitive.

key.name: cookies-profile
key.summary: Browser profile name or config path
key.description: Optional profile selector used with --cookies-from-browser. Choose the profile that is signed in to the target site.

key.name: proxy
key.description: Passed to yt-dlp for network requests. Example: socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Keep any embedded proxy credentials private.

key.name: rate-limit
key.description: Optional yt-dlp rate limit, for example 5M or 500K. Passed as a value to --limit-rate.

key.name: concurrent-fragments
key.description: Optional positive integer passed to --concurrent-fragments. Leave empty to use yt-dlp's conservative built-in default. Higher values increase parallel fragment transfers and can raise network, disk, and CPU load.

key.name: stall-timeout-minutes
key.description: Optional timeout measured since the last yt-dlp progress update. Empty disables stall detection; accepted values are 1 to 1440 minutes.

key.name: custom-format-selector
key.description: Passed directly as the value for yt-dlp's -f selector. See yt-dlp documentation for selector syntax.

key.name: custom-args
key.description: Additional arguments are parsed into separate argv items and passed directly to yt-dlp without a shell. Quote arguments containing spaces; only use options you trust.

key.name: download-thumbnail
key.summary: Save the thumbnail as a JPG next to the download

key.name: embed-thumbnail
key.summary: Embed the thumbnail into the file metadata

key.name: prefer-drc
key.summary: Prefer DRC audio for more consistent loudness

key.name: stop-on-queue-error
key.summary: Stop queued downloads after a failure
key.description: When enabled, the queue waits for you to resume it after a download fails.

key.name: playlist-limit
key.description: Applies to playlist URLs only. Choose all items, or the first 1, 5, 10, or 20 items.

key.name: post-download-action
key.description: Choose whether to do nothing, copy the saved path, open the download folder, or open the downloaded file.
